name: Branch and claim type
requirement: Declare Native descriptive or Swappable causal branch.

name: Code-verifiable evaluation
requirement: Record metric, split, version, horizon, candidate count, repository and commit.

name: Data and compute controls
requirement: Disclose training/pretraining data, overlap, compute, supervision and residual confounds.

name: Horizon sweep
requirement: Report official Z=20 plus labelled Z=4,8,12 diagnostics.

name: Backbone sensitivity and anchor
requirement: Repeat with weaker backbone and bounded non-LLM decoder.

name: Calibration
requirement: Report NLL, Brier, ECE and defined risk-coverage.

name: Prompt/checkpoint reproducibility
requirement: Record checkpoint, prompts, decoding settings, seeds and repeated runs.

name: Deployment cost
requirement: Record hardware, precision, memory, latency, throughput, calls, tokens and API cost.

name: Row-level provenance
requirement: Record source locator, protocol metadata, code commit and verification status.
